utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Priya speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Harriet Sutherland. I’ve been charged unarranged overdraft fees and I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can look into that. Before we discuss the account, can you confirm your full name and date of birth?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: And the first line of your address, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. I’m sorry you’re unhappy. Those fees will be refunded, so we’ll get that sorted.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: You can’t know that yet, though, can you? I want to know why they were charged.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll check the details. I’m logging this as a complaint. The reference is TB-604218.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. I was charged £30 last month and I don’t think it’s fair.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Understood. I’ll review the charges and the account history.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll own this and review it myself. I’ll call you by 4pm on Friday, 24 October, with an update.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: We’ll also send you a full written response within 8 weeks of today. That’ll explain our findings and what we’ve decided.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: So, I’ve logged the complaint, I’ll call by Friday at 4pm, and you’ll get the full response within 8 weeks. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that’s clear. I’ll wait for your call.
